props.rule: Pregame only. One leg per player (his highest-chance line priced -1000 to +150), at most 2 legs per game in a parlay, each leg in at most 5 tickets. Chance = 50% FanDuel no-vig price + 50% ESPN game-log hit rate (this season, plus last season's final 20 games at 40% weight, shrunk toward FanDuel when few games), then small adjustments: opponent points allowed (±3 pts max), NBA minutes trend, teammates out.
